title: Sagrada Familia Skip The Line Guided Tour
description: A local guide walks you through the basilica for about 1.5 hours, decoding Gaudí's symbolism and the engineering behind the columns. The listing says the guide is certified by the Barcelona Tourism Authority.
imageAlt: Sunlight through stained glass and columns inside the Sagrada Familia
bestFor: First-time visitors who want the full story

title: Sagrada Familia Guided Tour + Optional Tower Visit
description: A 1.5-hour guided tour with fast-track entry. Add a tower visit when booking for the view over Barcelona; the basilica decides which tower is open, and children under 6 can't go up.
includes: Tower visit: optional (extra cost), assigned by the basilica
imageAlt: Sagrada Familia spires with apostle statues
bestFor: Visitors who also want the skyline view

title: Sagrada Familia Entry Ticket with Audio Guide
description: Basilica entry with the audio guide app, without a live guide — explore at your own pace if you'd rather skip the live commentary.
imageAlt: Sagrada Familia basilica facade in Barcelona
bestFor: Independent visitors on a tight budget
